messages:
Lina (partnerships): Quick sync — vendor roadmap updates we got: NVIDIA H100->H200 ramp, AMD MI300 staggered ship, Gaudi internal lab waves. Need marketplace launch windows + joint PR timing.
Raj Patel: For NVIDIA, H200 availability bump to mid-July per vendor note. H100 still stable. They suggested soft-launch for Dedicated in late July.
Tess - HW PM: MI300 ETA from AMD is still "late Q3" — vague. We should ask exact ship weeks, not quarter.
Mike C: Gaudi partner said they can provide 4 racks for early testing in two waves (pilot / scale). Can we commit to a pilot in August?
Olivia SRE: We need driver/ML-runtime cert matrix before pilot. If we get images by 7/25 we can do a 2-week smoke and perf run.
Vendor: NVIDIA: Confirming H200 mid-July availability to partners. We can provide validation images and a limited quota for early customers. Embargo request: no public announcement before 7/30.
Tess - HW PM: Noted embargo. Does that block marketplace listing? We can have the listing staged but not visible.
Lina (partnerships): Staged listing is fine. @Marketplace-team can you confirm the ability to toggle visibility per SKU and per region?
Olivia SRE: yes — we can stage SKUs. Need exact AMIs/container-tags by 7/26. Also call out kernel+CUDA versions for H2.
Raj Patel: Action: Vendor deliverables: (1) Validation images, (2) Shipping windows per region, (3) Suggested joint blurb for PR. Deadline 7/26.
Vendor: AMD: MI300 precise weeks TBD. We expect an updated shipping calendar next week (will try for week of 7/22). No embargo yet but request coordination.
Mike C: SI partners need an integration checklist. I'll draft one: network config, NVLINK/IB, power/thermal, perf baselines, MFT/rdma tuning. Will share by EOD.
Lina (partnerships): Great. Also remind legal about co-marketing terms — I'll ping them for simple T&Cs and logo usage.
Olivia SRE: Risk: If H200 quota is limited, fallback plan should be H100 + quantized models on B200 for lower-cost tier. Add to routing policy.
Tess - HW PM: Agree. We'll prepare a staged rollout: Pilot (restricted), Beta (wider), GA (public). Timeline draft attached: Pilot Aug 7-21, Beta Aug 22-Sept 12, GA Sept 20.
Raj Patel: Can we get an internal go/no-go by Aug 1? We need perf signoff and marketplace readiness.
Vendor: Gaudi: Confirmed first pilot rack ships 8/1. Can provide early firmware. Request contact with our SI lead for handoff.
Lina (partnerships): OK — action owners:
- Raj: coordinate NVIDIA/AMD timelines
- Mike: SI checklist + runbook
- Olivia: staging + cert matrix
- Tess: rollout plan + fallback policies
I'll consolidate and send a single timeline doc by tomorrow.
Vendor: NVIDIA: noted. We'll send validation images and embargo copy by 7/25.
Olivia SRE: Added: Please include perf samples (latency p95, throughput) for prompt lengths 32/256/1024.
Lina (partnerships): Thanks everyone :thumbsup: We'll reconvene Tue 7/23 10am PT — invite incoming.
InfraBot: Calendar invite created: 'Vendor Roadmap - HW Launch Waves' Tue 2024-07-23 10:00 PT.
Tess - HW PM: tiny ask: tag any SKU that requires special cooling/power in the staging metadata so infra knows.
Mike C: will do.
Raj Patel: closing — ping me if vendors delay.
